brief_summary: Triple combination of metformin, DPP4 inhibitor and Thiazolidinedione would be a good option in the treatment of drug-naïve Korean type 2 diabetic patients.
brief_title: Therapeutic Efficacy of Triple Combination in Drug-naïve Korean Type 2 Diabetic Patients

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HbA1c 9-12%
* No treatment with insulin or oral agents for recent 6 months
* 20 ≤ Age \< 80 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to sitagliptin or metformin or thiazolidinedione
* Pregnant or breast feeding women
* Type 1 diabetes, gestational diabetes, or secondary forms of diabetes
* Not appropriate for oral antidiabetic agent
* Medication which affect glycemic control
* Disease which affect efficacy and safety of drugs
* Any major illness (Liver disease, Renal failure, Heart disease, Cancer, etc)

official_title: Therapeutic Efficacy of Triple Combination of Metformin, DPP4 Inhibitor and Thiazolidinedione in Drug-naïve Korean Type 2 Diabetic Patients
